# Community Feedback

This append-only ledger keeps the useful public feedback and external echoes
found during daily monitoring. It is not a metrics dashboard or a browsing log.

- Record the observation date, content, platform, public URL, evidence, current
  decision, and next useful checkpoint.
- Keep only feedback that can improve a response, article, research question,
  project, or publishing workflow. A concise "no actionable change" checkpoint
  is enough on quiet days.
- Do not store private analytics, personal information, full comment
  transcripts, or praise-only reactions.
